title: Tari Agent Registry
summary: Community-maintained registry of Tari-themed skills, agents and MCP servers, published through TariTracker. October 29 inspection of the AI Resources section showed four packages with source links and declared permissions. Packages use manifests, pull-request checks and maintainer review; these are not independent security certification. One development skill declares wallet signing/spending permissions, so installing a package is a separate decision from reading its listing. MIT registry at v1.0.0; no package was installed or executed. The recording walks through repository documentation. TariTracker is an independent community service, not an official Tari agent service.
cardSummary: Find community Tari skills, agents and MCP servers with source downloads, declared permissions and contribution guidelines.
